Install.dc.html.title: First open — add to Home Screen

web.text:
Same screens as the Android app, laid out for a phone browser. One link works on iPhone and Android; on a wider screen the same column sits in the centre.

Past weeks reuse the "Client training history" design as it is.

On the web Google draws its own sign-in button, so the one on the Sign in board is a placeholder.

ios.text:
Why Home Screen comes before sign-in: on iPhone, an app added to the Home Screen keeps its own storage, apart from Safari. Signing in in the Safari tab first would mean signing in again after adding it.

Android Chrome gets an Install button instead of the steps (Tweaks → Platform).

offline.text:
The web has no background upload. Logs are saved on the phone and sent while the app is open.

The amber notice on the current week (Tweaks → Offline) and "Sending to…" on the finished week (Tweaks → Sending) show when something is still waiting to go out.
